changelog: ⚡ Real-Time Live Ticking: Dashboard focus minutes, today's totals, and reports update dynamically every second during active sessions without tab switching

🌿 Multi-Pause Branch Timeline: Proportional segmented interval bar and expandable branch-tree diagram plotting exact start, pause intervals (e.g. 11:45 AM → 12:15 PM), resume timestamps, and net focus duration across multiple pauses in Day Log, Focus, and Reports
📊 Deep Pause Analytics: Dedicated Reports widget displaying average pause duration, shortest/longest pause, continuous flow sessions (0 pauses), and focus efficiency percentage
📝 Notes Editor Caret Preservation: Resolved autosave cursor jumps mid-paragraph; notes always open pinned cleanly to top; direct 1-click .md file export
⌨️ Markdown Formatting Shortcuts & Cheatsheet: Full keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+Shift+X/H/C/T, etc.) with an interactive on-screen cheatsheet modal (?)

⏱️ Focus Popout Lifecycle & Universal Breaks: Auto-finalizes at 0:00 (no stuck screen), provides 1-click break offers (+5m/+15m) for all modes (Pomodoro, Countdown, Flow), and restores main window on demand with RAM trimming
🔔 Soothing Downward Stopping Chime: Acoustic downward resolving chime (440Hz → 220Hz decay) on session stop across Focus, Popout, and mini-timer
🛡️ Sovereign Encrypted SQLite Storage: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption for all notes with zero plaintext disk dumping
🔤 System Default Native OS Font: Added native system font stack option in Settings for authentic OS look and feel
📱 Mobile Android Shade & Lockscreen Notifications: Full public lockscreen visibility, live MM:SS countdown & interactive Pause/Resume/Stop action buttons
🖥️ Linux Desktop Tray & Single-Instance: Permanent system tray indicator and instant window restoration on app launch
🌊 Reports Life Log Segregation & Deduplication: Pure deep work metrics, eliminated double-counting in Life Balance, removed ghost +30m additions, and purified work deliverables & estimate calibration
